subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should this PR's manual proof lock be accepted as the synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation and canonical proof observation?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well-proven, but the lock lifetime controls whether cancellation or canonical delivery evidence wins for queued chat messages, so owner intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after owner review confirms the manual lock/defer shape preserves proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, and cancellation ordering.

options.title: Tighten Lock Scope First
options.body: Ask for a narrower local scope that releases the proof lock before post-transaction outbox notifications while still avoiding actor-isolated closure capture.
